youtube_description:
Why can biowash reduce your t-shirt fabric weight? The cellulase enzyme used in biopolishing digests cotton cellulose and removes protruding surface fibres, so fabric weight can drop, and the GSM you specified before biowash may not be the GSM you receive. Always specify and check GSM on the finished fabric, not before the enzyme treatment.
